title: Battle of Nekmíř
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Nekmíř", at revision 1382409022, opens: "The Battle of Nekmíř was one of several raids carried out by the Bohemian Royalist forces, commanded by Bohuslav of Schwanberg, against Jan Žižka's Hussite troops." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1343168, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1419 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
